id.description: The fund's id from the brief, for example F1.

probability.description: Chance the fund stays above its category's middle fund over the next 12 months. Null when the brief has no base rate.

stance.description: What you would do: keep, add, stop_adding, switch or review.

points.description: Percentage points this reason moved the chance from the base rate; negative lowers it.

reason.description: One short plain-English sentence for the father. No digits: code states every number.
